We deliver forensic insight with speed and accuracy so you can manage risk and rebuild trust
Forensic services
Build trust and emerge stronger
Sudden disruption can shake customer and stakeholder confidence. Whether you experience a data breach, fraud, or a massive global crisis like the COVID-19 pandemic, an unplanned event has the potential to inflict catastrophic harm to your organisation.
But managed skillfully, such upheaval can create opportunities for your business to emerge stronger.
With PwC’s Forensics team as your trusted advisor, you’ll get back on track. And after critical events, we’ll work with you to manage risk and put safeguards in place to protect business value.
Our collaborative Forensics approach helps you:
Build agility, adaptability and resilience into your business
Determine facts quickly and accurately
Present credible solutions to your stakeholders
Navigate and effectively manage crisis
Restore business value after an impasse
Innovate and emerge stronger
PwC’s Global Economic Crime Survey 2024
Learn how companies can embrace risk to prevent economic crime and disclose its consequences for future growth through our Global Economic Crime Survey.
Read the report
How PwC can help
Our Forensics specialists help clients protect business value and recover from crisis.
With decades of extensive industry experience supporting organisations through critical challenges, our teams of professionals provide concrete, actionable advice to design and guide strategy. Advanced technology powers a suite of proven tools and services. Forensics specialists and analysts apply battle-tested skills and knowledge.
The results: Recovery. Resilience. Opportunity.
Prepare
Respond
Emerge stronger
Prepare
Prepare
We help you reduce the risk of fraud, economic crime and disputes, protecting your business from financial and reputational damage.
Respond
Respond
A crisis can cause enormous risk to your brand, your people, your relationships — and your bottom line. We respond with speed and conviction to address the threat and help prevent further damage.
Emerge stronger
Emerge stronger
Managed well, a crisis can help your business develop immunity. We work with you to recover from current crises and to enhance your ability to learn and improve after an unplanned event.
During an environment of global uncertainty, no business is immune to bribery and corruption.
PwC’s Forensics team offers an agile approach, empowering your organisation with the tools and knowledge to conduct global business safely and legally. We’re focused on helping you mitigate personal and corporate damage risks from the start, so you can emerge stronger tomorrow.
30% of companies experienced bribery or corruption during the past two years, according to
PwC’s 2020 Global Economic Crime and Fraud Survey
.
Fight bribery and corruption
Empower your organisation to mitigate damage and emerge stronger.
Fraud and economic crime rates have soared to record highs in recent years — even before the pandemic magnified fraud risk and tested the guardrails of organisations at every level. Today’s businesses face a perfect storm of fraud risk: internal, external, regulatory and reputational.
Are you prepared?
46% of organisations
experienced fraud in the past two years, according to
PwC’s Global Economic Crime and Fraud Survey, 2022
Combat fraud and economic crime
Building business resilience to face a storm of fraud risk: internal, external, regulatory and reputational.
It's not a matter of whether a crisis will hit. It's a matter of when.
To survive vast challenges like the COVID-19 pandemic, organisations must quickly mobilise a crisis response plan, stabilise business operations, and strategise for the future.
The
PwC's Global Centre for Crisis and Resilience
can support you through these critical waves of response, assembling multidisciplinary specialists across our network to help you emerge stronger.
93% of respondents to PwC’s Global Crisis Survey 2021 told us they expected to experience a crisis in the future.
Prepare for and respond to crisis
Mobilise your response plan. Stabilise operations. Strategise for the future.
Are you looking for answers? Do you need to know who, when, and how? Are you buried under a mountain of information?
When you’re facing an investigation, allegation, or crisis it’s essential to get the facts fast. We’re here to support you at every stage. Our advanced forensic technology works quickly to identify, extract, and analyse data and information, improving your position — and your ability to reduce the risk of a future incident.
71% of companies that emerged stronger conducted an investigation, according to PwC’s Global Economic Crime and Fraud Survey 2020.
Conduct forensic investigation & discovery
Advanced forensic technology will help you improve your recovery and reduce future risk.
Establish facts. Analyse the issues. Develop a dispute resolution approach. It sounds simple, but it can be time-consuming and costly to tackle on your own.
When a dispute arises, you need a team with deep experience and a proven approach. Our forensic specialists work collaboratively with you and your legal counsel, tapping into our extensive sector expertise to provide objective guidance — in litigation, arbitration, mediation, expert determination, and regulatory matters.
$42B in losses reported due to fraud during the last 24 months, according to PwC’s Global Economic Crime and Fraud Survey 2020.
Manage claims and disputes
Reach resolution with trusted guidance from objective, experienced sector specialists.
In today’s market uncertainty, regulators are holding organisations to a higher standard of compliance, and the risks of falling afoul are increasingly serious. We can help you navigate the maze — and seize opportunity.
Our Forensics teams help you emerge stronger from threats by designing and implementing fit-for-purpose enterprise compliance programs.
More than 50% of companies have bolstered their internal controls, policies, and procedures, according to PwC’s Global Economic Crime and Fraud Survey 2020.
Stay ahead of regulatory actions
Design and execute a fit-for-purpose enterprise compliance program that helps you ID opportunities.
If a large-scale project isn’t delivered as agreed, risks can include lasting damage to your business and stakeholders, disrupted strategy, and damaged reputations.
PwC’s Capital Projects & Infrastructure team
provides insight and expertise to put you back in control, giving you the tools to recover before it’s too late.
Succeed on capital projects
Benefit from insight and expertise focused on regaining control and recovering quickly from missteps.
